subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `lint-tech-designs`, docgate shall validate every design's closed header schema, typed `Serves` grammar (enumerated refs only), reference resolution — with `corpus:` references resolving against requirement IDs actually present in the flat placeholder-corpus files — mandatory-by-name Observability and Security & privacy subsections with the header pair, slug rules, and a Status row recording `Approved`; shall fail any design whose `Serves` cites a `prd:` ledger without at least one requirement-row anchor (FR-n, UB-n, or NFR-n); and, when a merge base is given, shall fail any design added since the merge base whose `Serves` cites a superseded or retired ledger unit. Designs merged before the v2 gate stay grandfathered; the config's precedence grandfather list (I1) exempts from the precedence clause only.
rationale: a resolvable stub must not read as a satisfied ordering rule (I1), an unresolvable corpus ref must not read as resolved, and dead intent must not anchor new designs (#54 A4)
fit_criterion: corpus-ref-to-nonexistent-ID fixture red naming the ID; the real corpus green (`local-work-tracker`'s corpus refs resolve); with a merge base, a new design serving a superseded FR red, a pre-existing design serving one green (flag only); a `Status: Draft` design red; grandfathered designs green; every FR-16 fixture keeps its verdict
